fields.explanation: The original two jobs (5,5),(1,5) assigned to separate machines satisfy every deadline. The literal source recurrence, implemented with Finset filter/union/biUnion and actual load sums, omits the resulting load (5,1).
fields.flaw: The refined recurrence for multiple machines correctly computes the feasible load vectors and supports the claimed multi-machine algorithm.
fields.problem: Title: The Art of Staying Ahead of Deadlines: Improved Algorithms for the Minimum Tardy Processing Time
fields.witness: Let m=2 and two jobs, already in nondecreasing-deadline order: (p1,d1)=(5,5), (p2,d2)=(1,5). Assign job 1 to machine 1 and job 2 to machine 2. Completions are 5 and 1, so load vector (5,1) is feasible.
